Bombay High Court Cancels Bail for Corporator in Doctor Assault Case

The Bombay High Court has cancelled the bail granted to a Shiv Sena corporator, Ramesh Mhatre, in connection with an assault on doctors. The court ordered him to surrender by 5 PM the following day. The decision was made after noting that the corporator had been implicated in 18 criminal cases.
